items.quote: The phases in each alloys were further determined by analyzing x-ray diffraction patterns generated by a D/ max-rA x-ray diffractometer with Cu Ka radiation.

After standard metallographic preparation, microstructure examination and quantitative analysis were performed by JEOL JSM-6360LV scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and JEOL JXA-8230 electron probe microanalysis (EPMA).

After standard metallographic preparation, microstructure examination and quantitative analysis were performed by JEOL JSM-6360LV scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and JEOL JXA-8230 electron probe microanalysis (EPMA).
The alloys were prepared by sealing mixtures of high-purity (99.99 mass%) powders of Co and B and pieces of Zn in quartz tube under vacuum.
items.starting_materials: powders of Co and B and pieces of Zn
items.synthesis: sealing mixtures of high-purity (99.99 mass%) powders of Co and B and pieces of Zn in quartz tube under vacuum

items.purpose: until an equilibrium state was reached
items.quote: The quenched samples were resealed in evacuated quartz tube and annealed at 450  C for 50 days until an equilibrium state was reached. At the end of the treatment, all samples were finally quenched in water rapidly to preserve the equilibrium state at annealing temperature.
Then they were heated to 1200  C and kept for 48 h, followed by quenched in water.
